info.title: mdrive API
info.description: POSIX-like file system API over S3

tags.name: auth
tags.description: Session lookup (login/logout/callback are handled by auth middleware, not exposed via this spec).

tags.name: fs
tags.description: POSIX-like filesystem operations on a drive.

get.description: Liveness/readiness probe. Returns 200 with `status: ok` when all configured backends respond.

post.description: Create a new drive owned by the authenticated user with the given storage configuration.

get.description: List drives owned by the authenticated user.
get.summary: List drives owned by the authenticated user

get.description: Return the drive identified by `driveID` (404 if not found or not owned by the caller).

put.description: Update the drive's name and description. Empty fields are left unchanged.

delete.description: Soft-delete a drive. The row is marked `deleted_at`; an admin can restore it within the retention window.

post.description: Restore a soft-deleted drive. Admin only.

get.description: List all soft-deleted drives. Admin only.
Return the storage configuration for the drive.

post.description: Create a directory at `path` in the drive. Returns 409 if `path` already exists.
Create an empty regular file at `path`, or update its mtime if it exists.

delete.description: Remove one or more filesystem entries. With `recursive=true`, removes directories and their contents.

post.description: Move or rename one or more sources to a destination. Source and destination must be on the same drive.

get.description: List the contents of a directory. Each entry returns its name, type, and inode id.
Read the file at `path`. Returns 404 if missing, 422 if the path is a directory or symlink target is not a file.

put.description: Create or replace the file at `path` with `content`.
put.summary: Write inline content to a file

post.description: Create a symlink at `link_path` with `target` (POSIX symlink(2)). `target` may be absolute or relative; the link may dangle.
Create a hardlink to a regular file at `src_path` (POSIX link(2)). Increments the source's nlink. Source must be a regular file (not a directory, symlink, or mount). Same drive only.
Bind-mount another drive's root at `mount_path` in this drive. Path resolution crosses drives via the mount.
post.summary: Bind-mount another drive at a path (POSIX mount-like)

get.description: Return metadata for the file at `path` (POSIX stat(2)). Follows symlinks.
get.summary: Get file metadata, following symlinks (POSIX stat(2))

get.description: Return metadata for the file at `path` (POSIX lstat(2)). Does NOT follow symlinks.
get.summary: Get file metadata without following symlinks (POSIX lstat(2))

get.description: Return the target path of a symlink (POSIX readlink(2)). Returns 422 if the inode is not a symlink.
get.summary: Read a symbolic link's target (POSIX readlink(2))

get.description: Resolve all symlinks and return the canonical absolute path.
get.summary: Resolve all symlinks and return the canonical (driveID, path) pair (POSIX realpath(3))

post.description: Create or replace the S3 object at `path` with multipart `object` content.
Start a presigned S3 upload. Returns the upload id and the URL to PUT the bytes to.
Mark the upload as complete. Verifies the S3 object exists, creates the inode, and links it into the parent directory.
post.summary: Complete a presigned upload and create the object node

get.description: Generate a presigned GET URL for downloading an existing object.
get.summary: Get a presigned download URL for an object node

post.description: Create or update a user record. Admin or self-service depending on `provider`.
post.summary: Upsert a user from OIDC claims

get.description:
Initiates OIDC login. Handled by the auth Service mounted at
the /auth path prefix; returns 302 to the configured issuer
(Keycloak). The OpenAPI
client cannot follow the redirect — use a browser.
get.summary: Initiate OIDC login (browser redirect to IdP)

get.description:
OIDC redirect target. Handled by the auth Service: exchanges
the authorization code for tokens (PKCE), fetches userinfo,
upserts the user, sets the session cookie, and redirects to
the post-login URL (or /). The OpenAPI client
cannot follow the OIDC dance — use a browser.

302.description: Redirect to post-login URL with session cookie set

post.description:
OIDC RP-initiated logout. Handled by the auth Service: clears
the session cookie and redirects to the IdP's
end_session_endpoint with post_logout_redirect_uri.

302.description: Redirect to post-logout URL with cookie cleared

get.description: Return the current authenticated user (200) or 401 if no session.

Forbidden.description: Authenticated but lacks the required permission.

Conflict.description: Resource already exists, soft-deleted, or version conflict.

UnprocessableEntity.description: Request understood but cannot be processed (e.g. wrong node type, hardlink source not a file).

ServiceUnavailable.description: A required backend is unreachable. Returned by /health when degraded.

NodeStat.description:
POSIX stat(2) / lstat(2) result. Mode is an octal bitmask
(chmod(2) bits | S_IFMT); ino is the inode id; the four
timestamps follow ext4 semantics. nlink is 0 for symlinks
and other special nodes.

mode.description: POSIX permission bits and file type (chmod(2) bits | S_IFMT). Unsigned 32-bit to match st_mode and avoid the gosec G115 signed-overflow boundary.

nlink.description: POSIX st_nlink (hardlink count). Unsigned 32-bit to match the internal representation.

ctime.description: POSIX st_ctime (inode change time, not creation).

revision.description: Internal revision token (ULID) for optimistic concurrency.

contentType.description: MIME type of the object (optional, included in the signed URL)

uploadId.description: Opaque token to pass to the complete endpoint

url.description: Presigned URL the client PUTs the bytes to

headers.description: Headers that must be included with the PUT request

key.description: S3 object key that will be created

checksum.description: ETag or checksum of the uploaded object (optional)
